consent_prompt:
Welcome to SoroEngine 👋
I help you keep your shop records and learn money tips. Just send a voice note.

We save what you tell us so we can answer you. We do not store your phone number. Type DELETE anytime to remove everything.
Privacy: {privacy_url}

Do you agree?
consent_declined: No wahala. If you change your mind, just send any message.
welcome:
You're set! ✅ Send me a voice note or text like:
• "I sell 3 bags of rice, 75k"
• "I buy fuel 4,500"
• "Mama Chidi owe me 5k"
• "How much I sell this week?"
• "How I go save money for my shop?"

Type HELP anytime.
help:
Here is what I can do:
🛒 Record sales: "I sell 2 crates of egg 9k"
💸 Record expenses: "I pay shop rent 30k"
📒 Debts: "Emeka owe me 4k" / "I owe supplier 20k"
📦 Stock: "I get 10 cartons of Indomie left"
📊 Summary: "How my business do this week?"
🏦 Loan: "I need 100k loan to buy goods"
💡 Money tips: ask any question

Type LANGUAGE to change language, DELETE to remove your data.

SoroEngine uses N-ATLaS, an initiative of the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, powered by Awarri Technologies.
sale_logged:
✅ Sale recorded: {what}{amount}.
Today's sales so far: {today_total}.
expense_logged:
✅ Expense recorded: {what}{amount}.
Today's expenses so far: {today_total}.
need_amount: I hear you, but how much? Send it again with the amount, like "I sell 2 crates of egg, 9k".
need_item: Which goods? Send it again with the item and quantity, like "I get 10 cartons of Indomie left".
summary_empty: 📊 Nothing recorded {period} yet. Start with a voice note like "I sell 2 crates of egg, 9k".
loan_logged:
🏦 Noted: you need {amount}{purpose}.
SoroEngine does not give loans itself. We are keeping your request so we can connect you when partner lenders join. Keep recording your sales: good records help you get a loan.
greeting: Hello! 👋 Send me a voice note about your sales, expenses or debts, or ask me any money question. Type HELP to see examples.
unknown: Sorry, I no understand well. Try again in short words, or type HELP to see examples.
unsupported_type: Please send a voice note or text. I can't read pictures or videos yet.
transcribe_empty: I no hear anything for that voice note. Please try again and speak close to the phone.
delete_confirm: This will delete ALL your records with SoroEngine. Are you sure?
deleted: Done. Everything is deleted. Send any message if you want to start again.
error: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
